The season started on 31 December 2011 and finished on 19 August 2012.{{cite web|url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/en/sports/12867/v-league-get-down-to-business.html|title=V-League get down to business|date=2011-09-11|work=VietNamNet.vn|access-date=2011-09-11|archive-date=4 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304123816/http://english.vietnamnet.vn/en/sports/12867/v-league-get-down-to-business.html|url-status=dead}} On 15 December it was announced that the league would change name and would simply be known as the '''Premier League'''.{{cite web|url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/en/sports/16562/v-league-to-have-a-new-name.html|title=V-League to have a new name|date=2011-12-15|work=VietNamNet.vn|access-date=2011-12-15|archive-date=7 November 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171107113623/http://english.vietnamnet.vn/en/sports/16562/v-league-to-have-a-new-name.html|url-status=dead}} Then, it was changed name to '''Super League'''.{{cite web|url=http://www.vff.org.vn/default.aspx?mod=DetailNews&fNewsID=17307&fCatID=53&fSncID=&fMscID=|title=VPF công bố Nhà tài trợ chính Giải bóng đá Ngoại hạng-Eximbank 2012|date=2011-12-22|work=VFF.org.vn|access-date=2011-12-23|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120107234445/http://www.vff.org.vn/default.aspx?mod=DetailNews&fNewsID=17307&fCatID=53&fSncID=&fMscID=|archive-date=7 January 2012|url-status=dead}} {{TOC limit|3}} == Teams == [[Đồng Tâm Long An F.C.|Đồng Tâm Long An]] were relegated to the [[2012 Vietnamese First Division]] after finishing the [[2011 V-League|2011 season]] in the bottom two after a season of upheaval and numerous coaches hired and fired. It was a far fall from grace for the two-time champions. [[Hà Nội ACB]] were also relegated after finishing bottom, but later merged with [[Hòa Phát Hà Nội F.C.|Hòa Phát Hà Nội]] to retain their place in the top flight. They were also renamed to [[Ha Noi F.C. (1956)|Hà Nội]].{{cite web|url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/en/sports/13491/new-football-clubs-for-hanoi.html#|title=New football clubs for Hanoi |date=2011-09-28|work=VietNamNet.vn|access-date=2011-09-28}} They were replaced by [[Vietnamese First Division]] champions [[Sài Gòn Xuân Thành F.C.|Sài Gòn Xuân Thành]] who were renamed to Sàigòn for the start of the campaign and then renamed back during mid season.{{cite web|url=http://english.vietnamnet.vn/en/sports/15870/the-first-fc-has-its-own-tv-channel.html|title=The first FC has its own TV channel |date=2011-11-29|work=VietNamNet.vn|access-date=2011-11-29}}{{cite web|url=http://tuoitrenews.vn/cmlink/tuoitrenews/sports/saigon-fc-to-return-to-old-name-says-chairman-1.67703|title=Saigon FC to return to old name, says chairman |date=2012-04-06|work=tuoitrenews.vn|access-date=2012-04-06}} and runners up [[Kienlongbank Kiên Giang F.C.|Kienlongbank Kiên Giang]].
